checks: Private empty creation precedes content; Unicode and spaced paths round-trip with stable identity
Missing opens and existing create collisions cannot create, replace or truncate data
An inherited child requires its containing protected root; absent and unrelated roots are refused without repair
An explicit broad grant is refused with or without a private root, without repair or data changes
Ordinary-file admission refuses multiple links and preserves the original identity after owned alias cleanup
A target junction is refused without following or mutating its target
Handle-bound same-volume no-clobber publication moves one complete file
No-clobber publication collision preserves both identities and byte sequences
Whole-file replacement preserves private ACL and uses the staged identity
Real sharing denial preserves old and staged files without fallback; retry is flushed after release
Exact-handle deletion invalidates that handle and preserves an unrelated sibling
Delete-sharing reader proves deferred deletion until final close; no journal completion is inferred
Pinned directory inventory is bounded, preserves Unicode and restarts after refusal
Private byte-zero locks contend with another handle and an independent Hermes-compatible CRT process
A nonempty pre-existing lock is refused and preserved
limits: Primitive acceptance only; production platform holds remain unchanged.
No Hermes runtime, model/provider, customer profile or credential is used.
No full application, installed GUI, Windows 11 device or power-loss guarantee is implied.
Ancestor pinning and ancestor-junction refusal belong to the separate portable protocol and are not established by this leaf-primitive script.
Successful deletion requests are not journal completion; namespace/journal reconciliation requires the separate protocol.
